title: Anti-Sexism Alert System: Identification of Sexist Comments on Social Media Using AI Techniques

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a manually labeled dataset of Spanish social media comments (from Twitter, YouTube, and digital newspapers) and fine-tuning a pre-trained language model (dehatebert-mono-spanish) to automatically classify and detect sexist comments. The system also evaluates the prevalence of sexism based on the gender of the content's main protagonist.
